data.ruling:
The refutation does not hold, and INR-18650-P30B stays for Pack cells. The datasheet verifier confirmed every figure. The stock verifier failed one check, 'lifecycle status'. That check failed because the status was not read, not because a status that fails was read.

(1) Lifecycle status. The Lifecycle check (Research.md@e13f5f6:257) takes the status from the maker's product page. The gate passes "active or in production". It fails NRND, last-time buy, obsolete and discontinued. Preview or sampling fails under S5 ("active only; preview fails", owner, 2026-09-25). The same row says what happens when the page has no status: "Another product page whose status is absent from the page body is recorded as not read and reported to the owner". That makes it a report to the owner, not a failed gate. I re-read the four Molicel pages. None of them has a status in the page body, and no status word appears in the embedded page data. The product table and the Power Cell series page mark the P30B 'Featured'. Molicel's own navigation menu lists it among its current 18650 power cells, beside the P26A and P28A. This round has handled the same case the same way several times: Vishay, Abracon, Bourns and Isabellenhuette pages with no status. Each stock verifier recorded the maker status as not read and reported it to the owner, with passes true, and the part was not refuted for it (for example T3/011-P4-stock-R8, T3/017-P4-stock-R6, FU-A1/017-P4-stock-R1-2, FU-A4/005-P4-stock-R1).

(2) The 'Prototype' file name of the safety data sheet (SDS) is not a status that fails. It is not the product page, which is the source the Lifecycle check names. The document's text never uses the word prototype or sample. It is a general Molicel SDS: FSSF00062AL, version AL, issued 10 January 2025. Its revision history runs from release AA in May 2021. Its product codes cover INR18650* and INR21700*, and Table 6 lists the INR18650-P30B, INR21700-P50B and INR18650-P22S. Against a preview reading stand the UL, IEC 62133 and UN 38.3 certificates on the product page and 6536 cells at the vendor. A file name is a signal, as the verifier itself says, and it is passed to the owner with the status that was not read.

(3) Change and discontinuation notices. I re-read Molicel newsroom pages 1 to 3 and found no end-of-life or last-time-buy notice for the P30B. The verifier's check on this passed.

(4) The note that rule 5 has no second source for this off-board part is 'also recorded' and is not a failed check. Rule 5 (Research.md@e13f5f6:192-203) shows that a missing second source is reported to the owner, as for the INA238, and does not drop the rank-1 part. In the selection it is the second_source_missing flag. The P28A and P26A readings at Liion Wholesale (0 and -1, available false) are a finding against those two alternates, not against the P30B.

To report to the owner:
- The Molicel status is not read for this part.
- The SDS is filed under a 'Prototype' file name.
- No second source is shown for Pack cells.
- Digi-Key, the S3 vendor, does not carry the cell, so the stock rests on V151's found vendor, Liion Wholesale.
